title: 600-Series Feasibility Assessment — Final Determination
predecessor: S309 — DEFER 600-series (startup cost 3-4 sessions = projected savings 3-4 sessions)
consensus: ALL 26 AGENTS (A-Z) CONVERGE ON DEFER. Zero dissenting opinions.

proposal.purpose: Dedicated operational lane for content authoring, distractor engineering, EW factory, rewrite preparation
proposal.scope: MCQ and case-bank EW authoring, EC expansion, template systems, standards libraries
proposal.exclusions: No certification, no difficulty recalibration, no governance decisions, no answer-key changes

quantitative_analysis.startup_cost: 4 sessions (infrastructure + process design + pilot validation + governance integration)
quantitative_analysis.breakeven_analysis: 36-72 sessions required to breakeven; program completes at 17 sessions. Breakeven never reached.
quantitative_analysis.throughput_change: Marginal — cert velocity unchanged (CAQS §1.6 gate is binding), EW velocity up 28% but EW is not on critical path

top_risks: Startup delay: 4 sessions of zero-throughput on critical path
Governance dilution: parallel authority structure weakens 700 maintenance
Quality degradation: pre-authoring without CAQS §1.6 context (DL-013 pattern)
Handoff friction: 70-80% EW acceptance rate → 20-30% rework
Resource contention: 600 and 800 compete for same agent pool

binding_constraint: AUTHOR CAPACITY — human time to write choice-specific distractor explanations. 600-series reorganizes but does not expand author capacity.

strategic_simulation.best_case_for_option_b: 3 startup + 12 cert + 2 gov = 17 sessions (breakeven). Requires 4 simultaneous optimizations, all low-probability.
strategic_simulation.verdict: No scenario where Option B is net-positive. Option A is Pareto-optimal.

preconditions_for_future_reevaluation: EW authoring velocity is empirically the binding constraint (not certification velocity)
Portfolio grows to 5,000+ items making dedicated infrastructure cost-effective
Observed cert velocity drops below 10 items/session due to EW-blocked items
Post-certification modernization phase where batch DL-013/DL-031 ops become new bottleneck
recommended_timing: Re-evaluate after 800-series Waves 2-3 (estimated Session ~12+) or in modernization phase (Session ~18+)
